blocks.heading: LESSON 2 · WHY CLOUD WON
blocks.board_text:
Today:
• Speed to market
• Cost shape (pay for use)
• Survive traffic spikes

Finova-shaped stakes with ₹.
blocks.ren_voice: Lesson 2. Companies fashion-ku cloud vanga maataanga. Speed, flexible cost, traffic explode aana survival — adhaan.

blocks.heading: BEFORE vs AFTER
blocks.board_text:
Before cloud:
• Crores upfront for hardware
• Weeks to procure
• Guess capacity wrong → crash or waste

With cloud:
• Start near zero
• Scale in minutes
• Pay for what you use
blocks.ren_voice: Cloud-ku munnadi startup months and crores waste pannitu product code ezhuduvaanga. Cloud-la small-aa start panni minutes-la scale.

check_question.question: Rendu business reasons solunga — companies cloud-ku move aana reason?
check_question.ren_response_if_correct: Speed and flexible cost — or spike survival. Nalla.
check_question.ren_response_if_incorrect: Launch speed and 20x traffic overnight think pannunga.

blocks.heading: COST SHAPE
blocks.board_text:
CapEx: big buy now, hope you guessed right.
OpEx: monthly bill that follows usage.

Cloud shifts most infrastructure spend toward OpEx.
blocks.ren_voice: CapEx = generator vangradhu. OpEx = electricity bill. Cloud mostly OpEx feel — bill demand follow aagum.

blocks.heading: FINOVA LENS
blocks.board_text:
Finova launches a festival payment promo.
Traffic can 15x for six hours.
Physical rack: crash or overbuy.
Cloud: scale up for the window, scale down after.
blocks.ren_voice: Finova festival traffic. Aru hours madness. Cloud-la window-ku capacity add panni apram release. Adhaan AWS bill.
